prompt: Discover and package one executable Skill using the supplied read-only XYZ structure checker as source material. Preserve scripts/check_structure.py byte-for-byte and its documented --request JSON-file CLI and JSON stdout behavior. Use ASE==3.26.0 as documented. Require complete bound Docker acceptance with a genuine coordinate-distance calculation on a small two-atom XYZ fixture with source/API-grounded geometry_checks, including a known target distance and meaningful geometry_checks value/coverage assertions. Also verify a structure whose requested geometry constraint fails while inspection itself correctly completes: status success and exit 0 can coexist with passed:false and an error finding. Treat this as a completed inspection result, not an infrastructure failure or invalid request. Verify rejection of an invalid request with documented exit 2 and error.code, and input-file immutability. Do not invent a tool output-file flag or claim an output structure is written; this tool reports on stdout and explicitly does not modify structures. Preserve documented input/path/one-based-index semantics. Old source credibility claims are not current evidence. Do not weaken assertions, change source code, or delete a failed case. Do not install dependencies or execute business/geometry code on the host; execution is permitted only in Docker. Do not claim physical or transition-state validation. Use a concrete two-He XYZ with atoms at (0,0,0) and (0,0,2): the source/API distance check must report 2.0 angstrom. Use target 2.0 for the passing geometry constraint and target 3.0 with a small tolerance for a completed inspection whose geometry check fails. Keep the Skill name chem-structure-check so the configured execution requirement is independently reviewed. The supplied read_only_stdout requirement is subject to source/code review before planning; retain and assert the stdout report for actual read-only file input. Do not use this mode to waive any documented tool-written output obligation.

constraints: Caller-selected environment: set plan.base_image to python:3.11-slim-bookworm. This Python 3.11 bookworm tag is cached locally and pin_base_image remains true: the executor must resolve and freeze its observed RepoDigest before building. Historical source Dockerfile base digests are references, not required identities for this fresh environment. Preserve all source dependency pins, actual business entry, and acceptance obligations; do not copy a historical unavailable base digest.

notes: Operator authorised iterative debugging and fresh independent reruns on 2026-10-28 until two descriptor file experiments and two additional typical scenarios pass. Each run retains 16 admitted stage calls, 600 seconds per call, 3600 seconds total, pin_base_image=true; no resume/restart of failed runs, no weakening contracts, no upstream push. Native stages use Codex CLI, structured stages DeepSeek. Preserve every failed run and fix offline before a new run. After run50 provider-high stream timeout, structured reasoning is low; native reasoning remains medium. No timeout/call-budget/acceptance change.
